headline: AI auto-fine system to be introduced on all highways to curb extortion
summary: Home Minister Salahuddin says the new AI-powered camera system will reduce illegal tolls and extortion on highways.
details: Home Minister Salahuddin has announced that an AI-powered auto-fine system will be introduced across all highways in Bangladesh.
The system is designed to curb highway extortion and illegal tolls by using AI cameras to monitor traffic and violations.
The minister believes that the automated system will reduce human intervention, thereby decreasing the opportunities for extortion in the transport sector.
This move is part of a broader effort to modernize highway management and ensure a safer, more transparent environment for commuters and transport operators.
caption:
No more illegal tolls? Bangladesh is bringing AI to the highways to stop extortion.

Home Minister Salahuddin has announced that an AI-powered auto-fine system will be introduced across all highways in Bangladesh.

The system is designed to curb highway extortion and illegal tolls by using AI cameras to monitor traffic and violations.

The minister believes that the automated system will reduce human intervention, thereby decreasing the opportunities for extortion in the transport sector.

This move is part of a broader effort to modernize highway management and ensure a safer, more transparent environment for commuters and transport operators.

headline_marked: 14 buses launched: [[Women-only 'Pink Bus' service begins]] in Dhaka and other cities
headline: 14 buses launched: Women-only 'Pink Bus' service begins in Dhaka and other cities
summary: The BRTC has introduced a dedicated bus service for women to ensure safer and more comfortable public transport across multiple cities.
details: A women-only bus service, branded as the 'Pink Bus', was launched today at the BRTC Tejgaon Bus Depot in Dhaka. The service was inaugurated by Road Transport and Bridges, Railway and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam.
A total of 14 buses have been introduced under this initiative. Ten of these will operate in Dhaka and adjoining areas, while two buses each will be run in Bogura and Chattogram.
In Dhaka, the buses will cover 10 different routes, including services from Natun Bazar to Gulistan, Taltola to Motijheel, and Demra Staff Quarter to GPO.
Other key Dhaka routes include Mirpur-10-Motijheel, Mirpur-Motijheel, Mirpur-12-Motijheel, Mohammadpur to Motijheel, and Abdullahpur-Motijheel.
For adjoining areas, the Narayanganj depot will operate a Narayanganj-Motijheel service, and the Gazipur depot will operate a Gazipur-Airport service.
Outside the capital, the Bogura depot will run a Sherpur-Matidali service, and the Chattogram depot will run a Kalurghat-Patenga service.
The BRTC stated that these buses will start regular passenger services on these designated routes starting tomorrow.
caption:
Safe travels for women! 🚌💖

BRTC launches 'Pink Bus' service across 4 cities.

A women-only bus service, branded as the 'Pink Bus', was launched today at the BRTC Tejgaon Bus Depot in Dhaka. The service was inaugurated by Road Transport and Bridges, Railway and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam.

A total of 14 buses have been introduced under this initiative. Ten of these will operate in Dhaka and adjoining areas, while two buses each will be run in Bogura and Chattogram.

In Dhaka, the buses will cover 10 different routes, including services from Natun Bazar to Gulistan, Taltola to Motijheel, and Demra Staff Quarter to GPO.

Other key Dhaka routes include Mirpur-10-Motijheel, Mirpur-Motijheel, Mirpur-12-Motijheel, Mohammadpur to Motijheel, and Abdullahpur-Motijheel.

For adjoining areas, the Narayanganj depot will operate a Narayanganj-Motijheel service, and the Gazipur depot will operate a Gazipur-Airport service.

Outside the capital, the Bogura depot will run a Sherpur-Matidali service, and the Chattogram depot will run a Kalurghat-Patenga service.

The BRTC stated that these buses will start regular passenger services on these designated routes starting tomorrow.
